resources.string: EdgeTaskbar draws a small dock above other apps so you can launch pinned apps from anywhere. Android requires you to grant this yourself in system settings. EdgeTaskbar cannot resize other apps; the dock simply floats above them, so keep it collapsed when you need the full screen.
Permission is still off. Enable \"Allow display over other apps\" for EdgeTaskbar, then come back.
Notifications: Android 13+ needs this permission to show the taskbar\'s running notification. The dock still works if you deny it, but the notification may be hidden.
Tap to start the taskbar manually
Pinned apps must have a launchable screen
